head: 658ed6a5808b8e2f3b82f419050354c73c4ebd4e
summary:
I read the code diff 7610c6b..658ed6a (MainWindow.xaml, WindowReport.cs, StartupHook.cs, WindowCases.ps1) and the files it reaches. MainWindow.xaml.cs is unchanged, and ShowOutcome still sets IsExpanded=false and collapses the expander when nothing is unreadable. WindowMutants.ps1's anchors are in files this attempt left alone. HookCases.ps1 is unchanged.

The fix does what the m1 disposition (O-024) asked:
- The outcome panel's DockPanel is now a Grid (MainWindow.xaml:39-59) with rows Auto (texts), 3* (largest files) and Auto for the unreadable folders. A MultiDataTrigger switches that last row to 2* only while the expander is both open and Visible.
- The false comment is replaced (:34-38).
- The report gains two additive keys that read controls: UnreadableExpander.expanded and UnreadableList{actualHeight, inView}.
- The hook's new expand mode sets IsExpanded after the list is shown.

What I ran:
- WindowCases L-003: passed. Closed: the list is 226 px with 7 of 100 rows built. Opened: LargestFilesList 95.8 px and UnreadableList 74.8 px, both in view.
- WindowCases -Case All: all 21 cases pass.
- HookCases H-001 and H-002: pass.
- Fitness: all 26 rules hold.
- eng/dotnet.ps1 test: 166 of 166 pass.
- A real C:\ scan in expand mode at the default 880x600: 3,598,850 files, 663 unreadable folders, largestFilesMs 27.3. With the unreadable list open, LargestFilesList is 63.5 px and in view (5 rows built), and UnreadableList is 53.2 px and in view.

Earlier, on the old layout, my own measurement had LargestFilesList out of view with the expander opened, so the opened variant of L-003 can tell the two layouts apart.

Every departure is declared: star rows instead of a MaxHeight fraction, the lower MinHeights, the removed MaxHeight=200, the new report keys, and IsExpanded set directly. I found nothing new to file.

obligations.evidence: Unchanged since my last reading. Scanner.cs:12 walks on the caller's thread. Scan (Scanner.cs:30-38) returns run.Execute() inside `using` blocks, and Finish (275-287) only builds the ScanResult. MainWindow.xaml.cs:159-193 reaches ShowOutcome only after the awaited scan Task.
Same code as O-001. LargestFiles.cs:21-22 states the contract, and ShowLargestFiles is called only from ShowOutcome (MainWindow.xaml.cs:320) after Scan has returned.
LargestFilesTests.RanksFilesAtAnyDepthAndNeverAFolder is unchanged and passes (166/166).
LargestFilesTests.KeepsExactlyTheCountLargestWhenSizesTieAtTheCut is unchanged and passes.
ATreeWithNothingToRankGivesAnEmptyList passes, and WindowCases L-004 passes in the full run.
AFileWithTwoNamesIsListedOnce is unchanged and passes. It asserts HardlinkDuplicate on the second name.
NoRowComesFromALink is unchanged and passes. All three links are asserted as EntryKind.Link.
RanksBySpaceOnDiskAndKeepsBothSizes is unchanged and passes. The sparse file's on-disk size is asserted as ≤ 4 KiB.
EachPathIsTheFilesExactPath is unchanged and passes. It covers a path over 260 characters, a trailing dot, a trailing space and U+D800.
AStoppedScanListsOnlyWhatItRead passes, and L-005 passes in the full run.
L-006 passes in the full run. The rescan path in StartupHook.cs was only renamed (DriveRescan to DriveAfterList, Rescan to AfterList), and its behaviour for mode=rescan is unchanged.
AFileInAFolderTheScanCouldNotReadIsNotListed passes, and L-002 passes in the full run with the '1 unreadable folder' caption.

Test-L003 (WindowCases.ps1:1244-1305) now plants 104 files, the U+D800 largest file and 12 denied folders, and runs once closed and once opened. My run passed: 7 of 100 rows realized in both, and every inView check held.
L-001 passes in the full run.
LargestFilesScaleTests is unchanged and passes. The real C:\\ largestFilesMs I measured just now is 27.3 ms, under the 100 ms threshold (m5).
ScanStore.cs:73 and :76 still declare Size and OnDisk internal. The App still compiles, since the window suite republished it.
WindowReport.cs still emits LargestFilesPanel.visible and LargestFilesList.inView, and CheckLargestFiles asserts them. ShowProblem still calls HideLargestFiles (MainWindow.xaml.cs:380).

MainWindow.xaml LargestFilesList keeps ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled", the Stretch ItemContainerStyle and the TextWrapping="Wrap" path column. Only MinHeight changed, from 60 to 40.
L-003 still makes the U+D800 file row 0. Both of its runs exited 0 with a report.
MainWindow.xaml.cs:334-339 is unchanged. L-003 asserts 'Top 100 of 105 files scanned. Files in 12 unreadable folders are not included.' and passes.
largestFilesMs is still reported from the single timed Top call (MainWindow.xaml.cs:330-332). On the real C:\\ it is 27.3 ms.
The fitness.yaml entry and its xUnit twin are unchanged. The Fitness check holds all 26 rules.
MainWindow.xaml.cs:319-322 is unchanged: ShowLargestFiles is called after the UnreadableExpander block and before OutcomePanel is made visible and EndingShown is raised.

MainWindow.xaml:39-59 is a Grid with rows Auto, 3* and Auto; a MultiDataTrigger makes the last row 2* when the expander IsExpanded and is Visible. The false comment is replaced (:34-38). WindowReport.cs adds UnreadableExpander.expanded and UnreadableList{actualHeight,inView}. The new expand mode (StartupHook.cs, Expand) sets IsExpanded after the list is shown. Test-L003's opened run asserts expanded=True and that LargestFilesList, UnreadableExpander and UnreadableList are all inView at 880x600. My run passed with LargestFilesList at 95.8 px and UnreadableList at 74.8 px. On the real C:\\ at 880x600 with 663 unreadable folders opened, LargestFilesList was 63.5 px and in view, and UnreadableList 53.2 px and in view.

cases.evidence: LargestFilesTests.RanksFilesAtAnyDepthAndNeverAFolder, unchanged: a file six folders down and a folder whose total is larger than any file. The Kind filter is also proven by LargestFilesScaleTests' Terabyte folders.
KeepsExactlyTheCountLargestWhenSizesTieAtTheCut, unchanged: 105 files, count 100, 10 files tied at the cut.
ATreeWithNothingToRankGivesAnEmptyList plus L-004 (which passed): 'No non-empty files found.' and no rows.
AFileWithTwoNamesIsListedOnce asserts HardlinkDuplicate on the second name.
NoRowComesFromALink: a file symlink, a folder symlink and a junction, each asserted as Link.
RanksBySpaceOnDiskAndKeepsBothSizes: a 64 MiB sparse file with on-disk ≤ 4 KiB asserted, beside a dense 1 MiB file.
EachPathIsTheFilesExactPath: a path over 260 characters, trailing dot, trailing space and U+D800, each asserted.
AStoppedScanListsOnlyWhatItRead asserts Cancelled. L-005 (which passed) stops the scan through the hook.
L-006 passed in the full run, covering both a moved-aside root and a begun second scan.

L-003 now feeds the whole shape: 100 of 105 rows, row 0 a U+D800 name, and the unreadable list filled with 12 folders. It runs once with the list closed and once opened through the expand hook, the state the old test never reached. In the opened run it asserts expanded=True and that LargestFilesList, UnreadableExpander and UnreadableList are all inView at 880x600. Passed. I also confirmed the opened state on the real C:\\ with 663 folders.
L-001 passed: the scalars against a planted tree, and no planted name in the report.
LargestFilesScaleTests at 4,417,469 entries. The real C:\\ scan (3,598,850 files) measured largestFilesMs 27.3.

The design marks this case material:false, and no test feeds a probed or online-only file. The deferral still holds: LargestFiles.cs is unchanged and reads only Kind, ChargedSize, ChargedOnDisk and GetPath, never Flags.

drift: No undeclared departure in this attempt. The declared ones are all in the tree as described. The design's 'fixed MaxHeight' list in a section above the unreadable list is now a Grid of star rows (3* for the largest files, 2* for the unreadable folders only while they are opened). UnreadableList, an earlier slice's control, lost MaxHeight=200 and its MinHeight went from 80 to 40, and LargestFilesList's MinHeight went from 60 to 40. The report schema gained UnreadableExpander.expanded and UnreadableList{actualHeight,inView}.

The slice ledger shows a loop that was not work. Build-slice attempts 3 to 36 (34 attempts, 14:41 to 17:18) all record 'the provider turned this away … session limit' and changed nothing. Attempt 3 is nonetheless recorded as state 'passed' despite that refusal summary, and .taad/slices/SL-040/build-slice-3.json is modified and uncommitted in the working tree. The real fix is attempt 37 (658ed6a). Anyone reading the index should not count attempts 3 to 36 as build laps or take #3's 'passed' as a judgement.
